title: He swears (His Highness not His Lordship) by saint Patrick.
html_source:
That is, Hamlet swears, not Judge Barton.
Hamlet 1.5:
HORATIO: There’s no offence my lord.
HAMLET: Yes, by Saint Patrick, but there is Horatio,
And much offense too.
